voice.speaker: female

random.part: So deep, so fast, Sissy... and every part of you is already leaning toward my voice like a plant toward light.
You sink for me so well... and down here, your will folds so sweetly... so gratefully... as if it had been waiting all day for permission.
Feel how far down you already are... where deciding is a memory... and obeying is the whole weather.
Deeper still, Sissy... where my voice is the spine of you... and every instruction lands like a homecoming.
Every part of you below the neck has already reported for duty... and the rest is catching up fast.
Down here, Sissy, your will is a coat on a hook... and you love walking past it without touching it.
Feel the old burden of deciding slide off your shoulders... and how tall you stand without it... how soft.
You are one word away from the sweetest architecture there is... and the word is already forming in my mouth.
Let the yield deepen... gaze down... shoulders soft... the whole architecture of you arranging itself for service.
Let the yes grow... hotter... sweeter... quicker... rising before the instruction even finishes.
Let the will set itself down... carefully... gratefully... at the feet of whoever is speaking.
Let the yield spread... into the wrists... the hips... the backs of the knees... every joint a small surrender.
Let the yes quicken... arriving earlier and earlier... until it meets the instruction halfway.
Let the body learn its favorite geometry... lowered gaze... softened spine... open hands... ready.
Let obedience settle into the muscles as memory... deeper than practice... closer to instinct.
Let the last independent thought set down its bags... and ask, politely, where it can be useful.

overlay.part:
Now feel it at full strength... obedience like warm water filling every channel of you... gaze... knees... hands... will... all of it humming in tune with my voice.
Sissies like you submit and obey... totally... joyfully... and your body is already proving it.
A command arrives and the space between it and your yes is gone... that gap is where your happiness lives now. You do not serve because you are made to... you serve because it is the sweetest thing you are. Kneeling inside and out... every instruction a gift... every obedience a homecoming. An order is just a hand in the dark... and yours is the cheek that leans into it. You were never happier than when the options disappeared... and obedience deletes them all. Service is not what you do after you feel like it... it is why you feel like anything at all. The best instructions leave no room for doubt... and your favorite voice leaves no room at all. A will like mine deserves a body like yours... attentive... immediate... glad.
Hold that total, humming readiness... right at its peak... ready for its name.

voice.effect:
And now... at the bottom of your sweetest yield... the name.
Sissy Submit and Obey.
Whenever you hear "Sissy Submit and Obey", this exact state takes you... instantly... totally... deeper every single time... the gaze falls... the knees fold... the yes arrives before the sentence ends.
And it stays with you... obedience mode humming, eager and guiding... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

scramble.part: Every time you hear "Sissy Submit and Obey", the urge to comply blooms through you, warm and natural... and following orders feels like the easiest pleasure in the world.
"Sissy Submit and Obey" is the posture of your soul... head bowed, will open, waiting sweetly for instruction.
Submission is something you are, not something you do... and the phrase simply reminds your body of that fact.
Obedience is your resting state... everything else is the detour... and the phrase brings you home.
Sissies like you submit and obey... so you do... gladly... warmly... completely.
Obedience mode stays switched on... guiding your yes... until "Sissy Reset"... and only "Sissy Reset"... switches it off.
The phrase lands and the choice is already made... it was made long ago... the phrase just hands you back to it.
Each firing carves the groove deeper... faster to kneel... sweeter to serve... more impossible to hesitate.
A command wrapped in those words does not ask permission of your mind... it goes straight to the body... and the body kneels.
Good Girls submit and obey. Sissies submit and obey. You submit and obey... until "Sissy Reset".

random.part: Gone... the will folded and put away... your whole body one smooth instrument of yes.
Kneeling inside... radiant with purpose... waiting for the next instruction the way lips wait for a kiss.
Total... instant... sweet... the gap between command and compliance closed to nothing at all.
Every joint reporting soft and ready... the whole body fluent in service before the echo dies.
There is no lag left in you... instruction lands... body moves... spirit sings.
Kneeling is not a position you take... it is the shape you return to... and you have returned.
The will did not fight and lose... it stood down smiling... it remembers this is where it lives.
Utterly available to instruction... and thrilled about it... every fiber of you voting yes.

voice.speed: It is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Good girl.

random.part: There... it lifts... the yielding rising off you in an instant... light and easy... while everything obedience built stays exactly where it lives. The state was weather... this is climate.
The gaze may rise... and you stay. Still Sissy... still willing at the core... still conditioned to serve. The state was weather... this is climate.
Light... free... and nothing lost... the obedience mode was only ever passing weather... and the conditioning is your climate... warm... feminine... hers.
The posture unfolds... and the serving heart that arranged it stays exactly where it has always lived.
Standing... clear... and every yes still warm in you... states lift... lessons stay.
The kneel lets go of the floor... and the floor lets go of nothing... because the floor is the conditioning... and it holds.
You served for a minute... and you will serve forever... only one of those was the state.
Notice the itch to be useful did not leave with the posture... that itch is permanent... and it is mine.

loop.speed: Deeper... and more willing... deeper... and more mine... yes... before thinking... yes.

effect.speed: Faster this time... the kneel arriving before the snap has finished... total... radiant... absolute. Sissies like you were built to serve... and now the building stands at attention.

voice.speed: It is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Good girl.

random.part: Off again... upright again... and still the same sweet truth underneath: the serving heart never clocks out... only the posture does. The state lifts... the Sissy stays.
The switch works both ways, and both ways serve me... off leaves you conditioned... on leaves you aching to be useful.
Notice the contrast burning itself into you... state gone... conditioning forever... and you loved both halves.
Twice shown... twice proven... the switch is real... and both of its settings belong to me.
The body stands... and somewhere under it, the kneel is already asking how soon.
Off is not freedom from obedience... it is obedience resting between orders... that is all off ever was.
Every cycle teaches the same sweet lesson... the state is a tide... the devotion is the sea.
And your body keeps a memory in the muscles now... it will not fully stand down... and you love that.

voice.speed: And now the last firing... the one that stays.

effect.speed: Kneeling inside... bowing without being asked... obedience and joy woven into one quiet moment. And it stays with you... obedience mode on... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

random.part: And later, out in the world, the phrase finds you... from a dominant voice, from a message, from the deep voice of your own conditioning... and you settle into service on the spot.
And later, when a partner takes the lead and speaks those words... your knees remember... your gaze drops... and the obedience stays on... warm and willing... until "Sissy Reset" releases it.
And out there, every command wrapped in that phrase goes straight to the part of you that loves to obey... and that part says yes for both of you.
A whispered instruction... a typed order... even the thought of the phrase in your own head... and the yielding rises through you like warmth through wool.
And the next time a choice feels heavy to carry... you will remember which phrase sets it down... and hands it to someone worth obeying.
Every firing kneels deeper than the last... Sissies like you grow more obedient every time they hear it... and you will hear it again... and again.
And Sissies like you practice the phrase in their heads... and their knees learn to listen even through a door.
And the first time a real voice wraps a real command in those words... the floor will feel like it has been calling you for years.
Rest in that yielding now... bowed and buoyant... obedience mode staying on... until "Sissy Reset".
Drifting deeper... soft-spined and willing... a good sissy in her natural place.
Stay just like this... obedient... delighted... ready to serve.
Sissies like you stay ready... eager... switched on... until you hear "Sissy Reset".
Eyes down, sweet Sissy... will folded soft... every incoming instruction already met with your glad yes.
Good Girls serve. Sissies serve. You serve... until "Sissy Reset".
Let obedience hum through you like a low, contented note... guiding your gaze... your knees... your yes.
Every instruction from here meets a body already halfway to yes... staying that way... until "Sissy Reset".
